title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 离职引发超11.5万签名请愿
originalTitle: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 因婚外情指控离职，引发超11.5万签名请愿要求恢复职位。支持者包括特斯拉CEO Elon Musk、Replit CEO Amjad Masad、Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney等，Nvidia股价周五下跌2%。
